description: Defines tensor-related utility functions, data structures, and compute functions for tensor operations within the torch::jit::tensorexpr namespace.

classes.name: TensorInfo
classes.description: Structure holding tensor dimensions and data type.

methods.name: getTensorInfo
methods.description: Retrieves tensor information from a buffer handle.

methods.name: normalizeAndCheckIndex
methods.description: Normalizes an index and checks its validity against list size.

methods.name: boolToInteger
methods.description: Converts a boolean expression handle to an integer expression handle.

methods.name: promoteToDtype
methods.description: Promotes an expression handle to a specified data type.

methods.name: promoteInputs
methods.description: Promotes a list of input expressions to compatible types based on constraints.

methods.name: promoteIntegerToDefaultType
methods.description: Promotes an integer expression handle to the default tensor type.

methods.name: promoteHalfToFloat
methods.description: Converts a half-precision float expression handle to float.

methods.name: demoteOutput
methods.description: Demotes an expression handle to a specified optional data type.

methods.name: broadcastShapes
methods.description: Broadcasts multiple tensor shapes to a common shape.

methods.name: valueShape
methods.description: Returns the shape of a given argument value.

methods.name: tensorOrConstant
methods.description: Returns a tensor or constant expression handle based on argument value.

methods.name: scalarOrConstant
methods.description: Returns a scalar or constant expression handle based on argument value.

methods.name: broadcast
methods.description: Broadcasts a buffer handle to a shape defined by axes.

methods.name: constant
methods.description: Creates a constant expression handle from an argument value.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps an input expression between min and max expressions.

methods.name: computeChunk
methods.description: Computes a chunk of a tensor with specified shape, strides, and device.

methods.name: computeTranspose
methods.description: Computes a transposed tensor with specified shape, strides, and device.

methods.name: computeExpand
methods.description: Expands a tensor to a specified shape and strides.

methods.name: computeReshape
methods.description: Reshapes a tensor to a new shape and strides.

methods.name: computeFlatten
methods.description: Flattens a tensor into a 1D tensor.

methods.name: computeCatWoConditionals
methods.description: Concatenates tensors without conditionals.

methods.name: computeCat
methods.description: Concatenates tensors with specified shape, strides, and device.

methods.name: computeEmbedding
methods.description: Computes an embedding tensor from inputs.
